features.feature: Resolve current managed asset drift for KOALA.md, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md without overwriting repository-specific guidance.
Keep `koala check` able to surface genuine managed asset drift with a narrow actionable health result instead of treating all local edits as healthy.
Fail closed when REVIEW/TEST preflight or validate infrastructure throws instead of silently advancing into TEST.
Preserve policy-controlled validate warn/skip semantics; only verifier import/runtime/parse failures should hard-block TEST entry.
Add a typed read-only lifecycle registry that records active phases, legacy aliases, transitions/events, rollback targets, terminal phases, and gate/oracle identifiers in one inspectable place.
Keep the first lifecycle registry slice read-only and avoid turning this story into a full story_advance decomposition.
Break focused smoke/contract verification when lifecycle registry facts drift from phase-flow, PHASE_TO_EVENT, or command-policy surfaces.
Keep lifecycle/process-fact hardening mechanically protected by contract verification when gate-facing lifecycle facts change.
